name: Heavy Gear III
storyline: Heavy Gear III tells a new story set during the Interpolar War, before the Black Talons were ever formed. In terms of continuity it’s closer to Heavy Gear I and Storyline Book 2. The story of the game will fill in some of the gaps that were left due to the sudden transition from the Interpolar War to an interstellar plotline.
summary: With Heavy Gear III, the franchise is returning to its single-player roots while exploring a new direction within an open world setting. The game will feature a sandbox map that brings the Badlands of Terra Nova, a key region within the Heavy Gear universe, to life. Here players can freely explore unique settlements and landmarks, engage in action packed fights, collect weapons, purchase equipment, train in skills, recruit followers and customize their own Gears [mechs] to suit their playstyle.
